title: ROI sweep at 180 messages
eyebrow: Nereus Vision · IMX708 on nereus002 · 2026-10-03 · card at ≈ 1.5 m
lede: Largest ROI that fits 180 msgs and is ≥ today's quality: 1600×900 (d 3.81, 178 msgs), and the Pi Zero encodes it in 8.5 s · 40 MiB. 2000×1124 and 2304×1296 also fit and the Zero encodes them, but they are WARN (tag edges overshoot / soften vs RAW); 3072×1728 needs 189 msgs at d 15; the full frame does not fit and trips the Zero's memory guard.

sections.title: Today's pjpg · card + checker (the bar)
sections.note: q80, 52,214 B, 182 msgs (its own 195-message cap). UPSAMPLED: the pjpg is sent at 1000×562 and shown 1.6× up to the sensor grid. Each side gets its own card matrix (the pjpg is the camera's ISP output, the RAW is not).

notes: Slider: left of the divider is the RAW reference, right is nrjxl decoded back to raw; both rendered by one function (bilinear demosaic, the camera's locked WB gains, clipped at sensor white, the RAW's own card matrix, sRGB). Only today's pjpg is upsampled.

ΔE reliability: 10 of 13 card colour patches are usable (≈ 190 px each, ≈ 47 per Bayer plane). red_orange sits in glare; dark_brown and magenta are too noisy (within-patch spread > 8 %). The grey patches are in the plastic-wrap glare, so white balance uses the camera's locked AWB gains.

The RAW's own ΔE varies 1.17–1.42 across three identical frames, so ΔE differences under about 0.3 are noise. A 3×3 fit on 10 patches is close to exact and flatters every image; ΔE vs RAW (no fit) is the cleaner compression-only number.
Tag sharpness uses the 2 right-hand tags (≈ 32 px); glare hides the left two from the decoder (they were placed from their black borders for the card geometry).

Pi Zero: the production rc_raw_jxl CLI (bm #120, e5, cjxl under its 250 MiB guard), run with an extra 700 MiB address-space cap and nice 10, while recorder_web / workbench / field_power_log kept running. Full frame: the guard stops cjxl after 2.7 s (rfb=mem); ≈ 260 MiB is an ESTIMATE scaled from the 2304 and 3072 runs (64 → 113 MiB).
Levers not tried: effort 7 (smaller files, slower), and a 195-message budget (3072×1728 fits at 189 msgs, d 15).
footer: Data: compression_study/presets/runs/sweep_20261003T203525Z (3 locked RAW frames, 86 ms, gain 1.12). Encoder: bm_cam_legacy PR #120 head bd6f38c; identical bytes on the Mac and the Pi.
